goal_text: Improve Top 25% performance while maintaining or improving underdog performance
diagnostics_summary: Model shows severe overfitting (8% train-validation gap: 70.77% vs 62.90%). Validation metrics degraded vs baseline: accuracy -5.1% (68% → 63%), AUC -0.038 (0.733 → 0.694), Brier +0.005. 15+ near-zero importance features (<5) adding noise. Stance features contribute minimal predictive value. Top 25% currently at 79.19% accuracy with excellent calibration. Underdogs show 121% ROI on top 10% confidence but struggle in +150 to +250 band (44.4% accuracy). Model heavily weights striking volume control (top 2 features), age difference, and takedown ability.

previous_iteration_result.summary: Removing low-importance features (southpaw_vs_southpaw, orthodox_vs_orthodox, num_common_opponents) catastrophically degraded underdog performance (-4.23% accuracy, massive ROI losses) despite small Top 10% gains
previous_iteration_result.key_learning: Low-importance features may provide value through feature interactions. Removing them can harm underdog predictions even when Top 10% improves slightly.

avoid_constraints: Do NOT remove features (learned from iteration 1 failure)
Do NOT add new features involving quality differences
Underdog performance must NOT degrade significantly (>2%)
strategy_pivot: Abandon feature removal approach. Focus on (1) regularization/hyperparameter tuning to reduce overfitting without removing features, (2) underdog-specific improvements, (3) probability calibration improvements
hypotheses: Increasing regularization (lambda, min_child_weight) will reduce overfitting and improve Top 25% accuracy without harming underdogs by constraining model complexity
Reducing max_depth will prevent overfitting while preserving all feature interactions, benefiting both Top 25% and underdog performance
Adjusting subsample and colsample_bytree will reduce overfitting through sampling-based regularization
Adding monotonic constraints can improve calibration for Top 25% predictions without feature removal
Targeted hyperparameter tuning can close the train-validation gap while maintaining underdog ROI
Probability calibration (Platt scaling or isotonic regression) can improve Top 25% accuracy estimates
Underdog-specific feature engineering (without quality differences) can improve the +150 to +250 band

proposed_iterations.rationale: Current lambda may be too low, allowing overfitting. Increasing lambda will penalize large leaf weights and reduce overfitting. This should improve Top 25% validation accuracy by closing the train-validation gap, while preserving all features to maintain underdog performance.

Higher min_child_weight prevents the model from creating leaves with few samples, reducing overfitting. This should improve generalization to Top 25% confidence predictions while maintaining feature interactions important for underdogs.

proposed_iterations.focus: Reduce max_depth to constrain model complexity
proposed_iterations.rationale: Current max_depth may allow too much complexity. Reducing it will limit interaction depth, reducing overfitting while preserving all feature interactions. This should improve Top 25% validation performance without removing features that underdogs depend on.

proposed_iterations.focus: Adjust subsample and colsample_bytree for sampling-based regularization
proposed_iterations.rationale: Reducing subsample (row sampling) and colsample_bytree (column sampling) adds stochastic regularization, preventing the model from memorizing specific patterns. This should improve Top 25% generalization by reducing variance.

proposed_iterations.focus: Apply probability calibration (Platt scaling or isotonic regression)
proposed_iterations.rationale: Top 25% accuracy at 79.19% could improve with better-calibrated probabilities. Calibration adjusts the model's probability estimates to better match true frequencies, improving confidence-based bucketing and Top 25% accuracy.

proposed_iterations.focus: Add underdog momentum feature for mid-range odds
proposed_iterations.rationale: Underdog accuracy drops to 44.4% in +150 to +250 odds band. Add a feature capturing fighter momentum specifically when fighting as slight/medium underdog to improve predictions in this range without removing existing features.

Mid-range underdogs (+150 to +250) likely represent more competitive fights. Add interaction features that amplify signal when skill differentials are small, helping the model better identify these close matchups.

proposed_iterations.focus: Fine-tune learning rate with increased iterations
proposed_iterations.rationale: Lower learning rate with more n_estimators can improve generalization by taking smaller, more conservative steps. This should reduce overfitting while allowing the model to converge more slowly to a better solution.

proposed_iterations.focus: Adjust scale_pos_weight for better class balance
proposed_iterations.rationale: Underdogs may be underrepresented in high-confidence predictions. Adjusting scale_pos_weight can help the model better learn underdog patterns, improving accuracy in the +150 to +250 band without removing features.
